sources.use: Population (latest estimate year), via Our World in Data CSV mirror

sources.name: UDHR in XML (Universal Declaration of Human Rights translations)
sources.use: Article 1 in each official language for the Language Sample game; language ↔ country via CLDR official-language data

sources.name: Wikipedia
sources.use: Reference link for each hand-written Historical Pin question, landmark, and some Export Guess rankings (scripts/history-events.ts, scripts/landmarks.ts, scripts/exports.ts)

sources.name: Observatory of Economic Complexity (OEC)
sources.license: CC BY 3.0 IGO (via UN Comtrade / BACI)
sources.use: Top-3 merchandise exporters for the Export Guess mini-game (scripts/exports.ts)

notes: Historical Pin and landmark questions are written by the project and link to a Wikipedia article for context; coordinates are approximate to the named site.

Export Guess rankings are a hand-checked snapshot (typically 2023) of the top three exporters of each commodity. They follow the cited OEC or Wikipedia table, not domestic production. Re-export hubs such as Swiss gold are avoided.
Playable set = UN member states (per CLDR territory containment) plus TW, XK, PS, VA.
Where the World Bank has no land-area row, areaKm2 is computed from the Natural Earth polygon and marked areaSource=computed.
Alternate and contested names come from scripts/name-overrides.ts and are best-effort, not a statement of recognition.
